title: Corruption in Exports
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: Godot 4.4.1 stable and Godot 4.5 dev4

### System information

Godot Engine v4.5.dev4.official.209a446e3 - https://godotengine.org OpenGL API OpenGL ES 3.2 V@0615.80 (GIT@406382a20f, I986008d073, 1704447428) (Date:01/05/24) - Compatibility - Using Device: Qualcomm - Adreno (TM) 710

### Issue description

Device: Edge 50 Fusion (Motorola)
Ram: 16gb (8gb original)
Storage: 256gb
Chipset: Snapdragon 6 gen 1

Video Report: https://youtu.be/yfMVTm1TTqs?si=mTbDKqFcYAZ38Rx5

Every time I export both in release and debug the game doesn't work. In the video I'm going to show, the logo flashes infinitely, it's as if the engine is trying to open the scene but fails and tries again, generating the loop. I've seen reports of the project being exported and not working since 4.3 stable. But it seems to have gotten worse in this update. To be clear, the game works perfectly in the editor, but in the export it breaks.

### Steps to reproduce

Create a complex scene, with scripts and some 3D nodes, configure the scene to run at the beginning of the project and finally export the project as an apk (I don't know if the problem also occurs on other platforms). If everything is correct when exporting the same problem I am facing should occur. 

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

I'm working on this but the problem is quite confusing, is it some resource that export causes a problem?
